subject: A quick project update and one clarification
text:
Hi,

I wanted to give you a quick update on where things stand before the next checkpoint, because I think I might have misread one of the earlier notes and I don't want to keep guessing in silence. The team spent most of yesterday reviewing the vendor options, and everyone is leaning toward the smaller supplier since their response times seem much better and they are more open to adjusting the timeline. That part feels straightforward. What still feels fuzzy is the part where you said to keep the scope 'as flexible as possible while still being useful' for the department heads. I think I understand the intent, but I am not sure whether that means we should add a few extra examples now or leave them out and gather those requests later.

Another small thing: the revised budget sheet is ready, but I did not send it out yet because the column heading is still unclear. Is it for committed spend only, or does it include the preliminary costs we have not finalized? I would rather ask now than put together something that needs to be changed twice. Also, the demo script is in review, and the feedback so far is mostly about pacing rather than accuracy, which is reassuring. If I can get a short clarification on the instruction about examples and budget categories, I think we will be in a much clearer spot by tomorrow morning.

Anyway, I am still tracking on the usual deadline, but I wanted to flag these two points early rather than surprise you at the check-in.
